name: AR6
description: IPCC AR6 WG1 Chapter 7 emission-metric parameters, as in the IPCC-WG1/Chapter-7 code that generated Table 7.SM.7. No carbon-cycle feedback for non-CO2 gases (decision D3 on #26; issue #33), so CH4 and N2O metrics are lower than the AR6 headline values.

forster2021.citation: Forster, P., et al., 2021: The Earth's Energy Budget, Climate Feedbacks, and Climate Sensitivity. In: Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis. IPCC AR6 WG1, Chapter 7, pp. 923-1054. Supplementary Material (Smith et al. 2021) Tables 7.SM.5-7.SM.7.

ipcc_ch7_code.citation: Smith, C. J., et al., 2021: Figure and data generation for Chapter 7 of the IPCC's Sixth Assessment Report, Working Group 1. github.com/IPCC-WG1/Chapter-7. Values read at commit 2f948c8 (notebooks/335_chapter7_generate_metrics.ipynb, src/ar6/metrics/), which is later than the v1.0 Zenodo release.

meinshausen2020.citation: Meinshausen, M., et al., 2020: The shared socio-economic pathway (SSP) greenhouse gas concentrations and their extensions to 2500. Geosci. Model Dev., 13, 3571-3605. Table 3, as coded in FaIR 1.6.2 meinshausen().

joos2013.citation: Joos, F., et al., 2013: Carbon dioxide and climate impulse response functions for the computation of greenhouse gas metrics: a multi-model analysis. Atmos. Chem. Phys., 13, 2793-2825.

trenberth_smith2005.citation: Trenberth, K. E. and Smith, L., 2005: The mass of the atmosphere: a constraint on global analyses. J. Climate, 18, 864-875.

irf_a.where: As used by AR6 (ipcc_ch7_code nb335 `a=`). a0 is the permanent fraction.

irf_tau.where: As used by AR6 (ipcc_ch7_code nb335 `alpha_co2=`), decaying pools a1..a3

radiative_efficiency.where: scripts/derive_ar6_radiative_efficiency.py: +1 ppm above 2019 (409.9 ppm), formula re-referenced to 2019 as in ipcc_ch7_code co2_analytical(), times (1 + 0.05) rapid adjustment
radiative_efficiency.note: Decision D1 on #26 (unrounded). The slope of the 1750-referenced formula at 2019 would be 1.3877e-05 and does not reproduce the published AGWP100.

radiative_efficiency_scale.where: No scaling: AR6 uses the RE above directly

radiative_efficiency.where: scripts/derive_ar6_radiative_efficiency.py: +1 ppb above 2019 (1866.3 ppb), as in ipcc_ch7_code ch4_analytical(), times (1 - 0.14) rapid adjustment

h2o.where: src/ar6/metrics/ch4.py ch4_h2o (stratospheric water vapour from CH4)

fossil_co2_yield.unit: mol CO2 per mol CH4 removed
fossil_co2_yield.where: Table 7.15 footnote or 7.SM: not yet confirmed
fossil_co2_yield.note: Decision D4 on #26: null until confirmed. ClimateParameters.fossil_ch4_co2_yield() raises instead of guessing.

radiative_efficiency.where: scripts/derive_ar6_radiative_efficiency.py: +1 ppb above 2019 (332.1 ppb), as in ipcc_ch7_code n2o_analytical(), times (1 + 0.07) rapid adjustment

ch4_change.where: src/ar6/metrics/n2o.py f_n2o_ch4 (CH4 destroyed per N2O, after AR5 8.SM.11.3.3)

q.note: Decision D2 on #26. The notebook also has q2 = 0.319591049742508 ("Zeb's file", commented out); only 0.313998 reproduces AGTP100(CO2) = 3.95e-16.

mass.where: Total mass of the atmosphere (ipcc_ch7_code constants.py M_ATMOS)
